documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local ops.csr_softmax docstring accepts a CSRTensor and dtype, returns a CSRTensor, and lists GPU and CPU as supported platforms.
The local implementation constructs SparseMatrixSoftmax(dtype), then converts the returned shape Tensor through shape.asnumpy().tolist() before returning a CSRTensor.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: Graph mode fails before returning the softmax result.
Not an invalid sparse input issue: PyNative returns a CSRTensor tuple, and CSR/COO controls pass in Graph mode on CPU.
Not a random/nondeterministic issue: the same Graph error reproduces in three independent runs.
The Graph error is localized to the csr_softmax implementation path: 'The Map operator don't support Closure with free variable yet'.
